text:
Maya: Heads-up — after last night's KMS rotation (alias key-prod -> key-prod-v2) a few off-hours restores in staging failed with decrypt errors. @Sam @Liam can you take a look?
Sam: On it. Which tenants? any common pattern?
Maya: tenant=analytics-service and tenant=partner-sandbox. Error looks like 'AccessDenied: User does not have kms:Decrypt' but we didn't change role bindings.
Liam: Could be grant propagation delay or ephemeral grant TTL mismatch. Did the rotation re-grant the backup-uploader principal?
Sam: Checking audit logs now. Fetching KMS grant events + snapshot metadata. Will paste snippets.
Sam: ```
2024-03-20T02:15:03Z KMS CreateGrant grantId=abcd-1234 keyId=arn:aws:kms:...:key-prod-v2 principal=backup-uploader
2024-03-20T02:20:10Z S3 PutObject snapshot=snap-20240320-0219 metadata:cme-kms=false
2024-03-20T03:04:12Z Restore DecryptFailed AccessDenied principal=service-restorer@redwood
```
Maya: hmm metadata shows cme-kms=false — uploader may have skipped setting SSE-CMK header during rotation window.
Zara: If objects lack SSE-CMK metadata, restore will try default key and fail if default is disabled. Suggest: 1) rollback plan, 2) one-off scan for recent uploads missing CMEK tags, 3) validate uploader agent.
Liam: Temporary mitigation: add a fallback in the restore playbook to request a short-lived grant or to allow a controlled fallback to the previous key for restores only.
Sam: We should update RBAC playbook: when rotating keys, ensure backup-uploader role receives explicit kms:Decrypt grants and that GrantTokens (if used) are handled. Also add a pre-rotation check verifying uploader sets SSE-CMK headers on PUTs.
encops-bot: Incident created INC-2024-3489 — severity=P2 — assigned to Eng-SRE + EncOps. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/kms-rotation-checks
Maya: Action items: 1) Sam verify grants for affected tenants, 2) Zara run quick scan for uploads missing CME metadata, 3) Liam add pre-rotation checklist item. I'll draft rollback playbook.
Sam: quick note: audit logs show CreateGrant succeeded but one call returned ResourceMismatch — possible eventual consistency between alias and key-id during roll.
Zara: I'll deploy a short Lambda to scan bucket 'snapshots-prod-staging' for uploads between 02:00-03:30 missing the x-amz-server-side-encryption-key-id header.
Maya: If rollback required we can re-enable key-prod for read-only restores and schedule a re-encrypt job; compliance sign-off required.
Liam: Long-term: add a canary restore in the rotation pipeline that attempts to restore a small snapshot and validate decrypt before promoting the new key.
Sam: Commands to check state: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/key-prod-v2` and `aws s3api head-object --bucket snapshots-prod-staging --key <obj> --query Metadata`
Maya: Thanks. I'll update the playbook and ping @Compliance once we have remediation. cc @encops-bot when done.
Zara: Started scan, will report in ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Found one snapshot with grantId present but KMS event shows status 'Pending' — might be throttled CreateGrant. If this is widespread I'll open a provider support ticket.
encops-bot: Support ticket created with KMS provider: TICKET-78921
Maya: Solid. Keep updates concise. If someone triggers rollback, @mention me and @Compliance in thread.
